description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'AbstractEndpointTest' that validates the behavior of the 'Endpoint' class in the 'OrangeHRM' human resource management system. The tests cover validation of request parameters, setting and retrieving request data, and ensuring proper handling of sorting, pagination, and filtering parameters in API endpoints. It uses mock objects and protected method invocations to verify internal logic of the Endpoint class.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'Endpoint' class within the OrangeHRM Core API, particularly its request parameter handling, validation logic, and sorting/pagination features. It employs mock objects, protected method invocation, and data providers to cover various scenarios.

methods.name: testEndpoint
methods.description: Validates that the mocked Endpoint returns instances of Request, RequestParams, and ValidationDecorator from its protected methods.

methods.name: testGetSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Checks the correctness of the sorting and pagination parameter rules generated by the Endpoint.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected 'getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules' method of Endpoint.

methods.name: testSortOrderParamsRules
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the 'sortOrder' parameter, including valid values and exception for invalid.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRules
methods.description: Tests validation rules for 'limit' parameter, including edge cases and integer bounds.

methods.name: limitParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data for exception testing of 'limit' parameter.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRules
methods.description: Validates 'offset' parameter rules with valid and boundary values.

methods.name: offsetParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data to test invalid 'offset' values.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRules
methods.description: Validates 'sortField' parameter rules with acceptable values and edge cases.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Checks that invalid 'sortField' values cause exceptions.

methods.name: testSetRequestParams
methods.description: Verifies setting request parameters on Endpoint updates the internal RequestParams object.

methods.name: testSetSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Checks that sorting and pagination query parameters are correctly parsed and assigned to FilterParams.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParamsDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider supplying different query parameter sets for pagination/sorting tests.

methods.name: getMockEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a mock Endpoint instance with a specified query, initializing its request object.
